title: A worker's gotcha becomes team knowledge
trigger: a worker hits a gotcha and keeps working

steps.text: At the end of a turn, after ~150k tokens of growth since its last entry, the plugin flushes.
The worker's own model writes a five-section entry (session.generate adds no turn).
The plugin appends it with `coordlite journal`.
When 8 entries are pending, or once a day, the plugin asks the master to compile.
The master starts knowledge-compile in a background subagent, which loads the backlog.
The compiler checks the claim at HEAD and writes or edits a lesson under the right concept.
It records a receipt on each node it touched.
It marks the entries compiled, naming the nodes they went into.
The next session to start gets the knowledge index, now including the lesson, in its system prompt.
